name: niro-mcp-and-cli
stderr:
Usage: niro [options] [command]

Niro CLI — onboard repos, build indexes, manage projects from the terminal.

Options:
  -V, --version                  output the version number
  --api-url <url>                override API base URL (default: $NIRO_API_URL
                                 or https://aiorchestrator.niroai.dev)
  -h, --help                     display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                Log in to Niro. Default: device authorization
                                 in your browser. (--api-key or --password for
                                 alternatives.)
  logout                         Remove locally stored credentials.
  whoami [options]               Print the account currently logged in.
  init [options] [path]          Onboard a local repo end-to-end: create
                                 project, register repo, scan env vars, build
                                 index.
  add                            Add a repo or project.
  info [options] [path]          Show what Niro knows about this folder: git
                                 info + which project(s) it maps to and their
                                 status.
  edit [options]                 Change an existing project: map/unmap repos,
                                 set/list/rescan env vars (incl. choosing which
                                 file drives a var or which property files to
                                 consider), or rename.
  remove [options]               Remove a whole project (destructive) or unmap
                                 a single repo from it.
  watch [path]                   Resume watching an already-registered local
                                 repo (use after restart).
  status [options] [project_id]  Show the current build status for a project.
  projects|ls [options]          List the projects in your account
                                 (account-wide; use `niro info` for the current
                                 folder).
  build [options] [project_id]   Trigger a rebuild and watch it to completion.
  delete [options] [project_id]  Delete a project from the server
                                 (destructive). Uses .niro-project if no id is
                                 given.
  service                        Manage the niro-watch background daemon
                                 (auto-sync on login).
  mcp                            MCP server helpers.
  help [command]                 display help for command
